# Bundled images

## app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/subtitle_preview_frame.webp

The background of the caption preview in Settings › Subtitles.

- Photo: "Well lit soccer stadium" (Volksparkstadion, Hamburg) by Mario Klassen
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Well_lit_soccer_stadium_(Unsplash).jpg
  (originally https://unsplash.com/photos/70YxSTWa2Zw, published before Unsplash's June 2017 license change)
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication
- Changes: the 1280px Commons rendition, cropped to 16:9 and scaled to 960x540, WebP quality 72.
